g.text: Parse layer count, z threshold, cap and sample words
Map tier0; parse model config and vocabulary
Load model.safetensors embedding, unembedding and final norm
Measure normalized embedding similarity and direct output signatures
Normalize original embeddings using layer input norm
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. The normal handler reports candidate circuit signatures; it contains no database
persistence/admission step. Deeper layers use original embeddings rather than an actual
residual trajectory. Parsing, tensor validation and lp_rowsig remain nested. Numeric
option reads do not consistently check that a following argument exists. Build branch is
source evidence, not a claim about an installed binary.
